topic: how to find full credit card number chase app
slug: how to find full credit card number chase app

steps.narration: Open the Chase app and sign in.
Tap your Freedom Unlimited credit card on the home screen.
Scroll to the account services section and tap "Show card number".
Verify it's you: enter the 6-digit code Chase sends to your phone.
The Card details screen shows your full 16-digit card number: 4147 1120 5534 7710.
Use it for online purchases, then hide the screen when you're done.
